{{Top}}
A '''particle beam''' was a form of projectile that utilized coherent particles of energy that could be fired from a [[particle beam blaster]] or [[particle cannon turret]]. The beam, usually a pale yellow bolt, differed from a normal particle bolt emitted from [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], in that a particle beam utilized particles that were less densely packed but much more energized, resulting in a bolt that was unstable but very powerful.<ref name="BF">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

Particle beams acted like blaster bolts when fired, but due to their unstable nature, would explode violently upon contact with a solid object or energy field. This made them extremely valuable in artillery weapons, such as the particle cannon turret, as well as an effective backup weapon, as seen in the [[police cruiser backup unit]]'s [[particle beam blaster]]. Particle beams were thus also very effective against [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-wielding opponents; even a rifle-grade particle beam blaster couldn't be deflected by a lightsaber, as it would explode in a low-yield burst upon contact.<ref name="CN">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref>

"Particle beam" was a term that could also refer to the final bolt that was fired from a standard [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
